strings.zh: 真琴
strings.en: Brent
strings.notes: 真琴 not in 0719; US contact Poké Maniac Brent (US 0688)

strings.zh: 你是精灵爱好者吧？{NEWLINE}不用说我也知道！{SCROLL}不过你现在还很嫩啊！{SCROLL}你认识正辉先生吗？{NEWLINE}他是个很厉害的爱好者,{CLEAR}是我的偶像。{SCROLL}我会告诉你很多{NEWLINE}正辉先生的事,{CLEAR}怎么样？和我交换一下{CLEAR}电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: By the way, you’re a Poké Maniac...{NEWLINE}I can tell. Yes, you are.{SCROLL}But your knowledge is shallow still!{SCROLL}Do you know Bill?{NEWLINE}He’s an incredible Poké Maniac.{CLEAR}I revere him.{SCROLL}I’ll teach you all I know about Bill,{NEWLINE}so leave me your phone number. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 正辉先生很厉害的！{SCROLL}我也想有一天能成为{NEWLINE}像他一样了不起的爱好者！
strings.en: Bill--he’s more than amazing!{SCROLL}To be a Poké Maniac like him someday...{NEWLINE}That’s my dream.

strings.zh: 下次一定要和我{NEWLINE}交换号码啊！
strings.en: Next time, you’d better{NEWLINE}trade numbers with me!

strings.zh: 我会告诉你很多{NEWLINE}正辉先生的事,{CLEAR}怎么样？和我交换一下{CLEAR}电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’ll teach you all I know about Bill,{NEWLINE}so leave me your phone number. {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哦？你也喜欢{NEWLINE}在附近打电话吗？{SCROLL}我在家里也经常和{NEWLINE}我妈妈这样说话的。
strings.en: Huh? You like calling from nearby too?{SCROLL}I talk to my mom like this at home all{NEWLINE}the time.
strings.notes: US 0688/6 | RV072: grammar: stray question mark

strings.zh: 话说前几天{NEWLINE}我通过交换{CLEAR}得到了一只很少见的精灵。{CLEAR}你想知道是什么精灵吗？{SCROLL}哼哼哼,{NEWLINE}就不告诉你。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Oh yeah, I got a really rare{NEWLINE}Pokémon in a trade the other{CLEAR}day. Want to know what it is?{SCROLL}Heh heh heh, I’m not telling.{SCROLL}...So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 啊,对了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}不久前我打倒了{VAR:0100:11},{SCROLL}因为它还不值得{NEWLINE}我去抓。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Oh yeah, I took down{NEWLINE}this wild {VAR:0100:11}.{SCROLL}It wasn’t rare enough{NEWLINE}to bother catching.{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 啊,对了⋯⋯{NEWLINE}一个小时前{CLEAR}我看到了一只很少见的精灵,{SCROLL}那还是我第一次看到⋯{NEWLINE}不过我刚好没带精灵球,{CLEAR}所以抓不了⋯{SCROLL}像我这样的失态{NEWLINE}绝对会被正辉先生笑的吧？{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Oh yeah, I saw a rare Pokémon about{NEWLINE}an hour ago.{SCROLL}It was my first sighting. But I{NEWLINE}didn’t have any Poké Balls...{SCROLL}Would Bill laugh at my mistakes?{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生的爸爸{CLEAR}也是个很厉害的爱好者。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...?{NEWLINE}Bill’s father is supposed to be a{CLEAR}great Poké Maniac.{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生的爷爷{CLEAR}好像也是个爱好者。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...? Apparently Bill’s{NEWLINE}grandpa is a Poké Maniac, too.{SCROLL}...So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生的老家{CLEAR}好像是在满金市。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...?{NEWLINE}Bill’s originally from Goldenrod.{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生好像住在关东的{CLEAR}２５号道路。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...?{NEWLINE}Bill evidently lives on Route 25{CLEAR}in Kanto.{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生最近抓获的{CLEAR}精灵好像是凯西。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...? Apparently the Pokémon{NEWLINE}Bill caught most recently is an Abra.{SCROLL}...So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生的妹妹{CLEAR}好像不会眨眼睛。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...? Apparently{NEWLINE}Bill’s younger sister can’t blink.{SCROLL}...So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生很讨厌牛奶,{CLEAR}基本上完全不喝。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...?{SCROLL}Bill hates milk and basically never{NEWLINE}drinks it. ...So that’s it then.
strings.notes: US 0688/16 | RV072: meaning: never drinks, not can't

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生不太擅长{CLEAR}精灵对战。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...? Evidently, Bill{NEWLINE}isn’t very good at battling.{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生似乎{CLEAR}非常喜欢花店的姐姐。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...?{NEWLINE}Bill appears to like the lady at the{CLEAR}Flower Shop.{SCROLL}So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生的妈妈{CLEAR}以前好像是舞女。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...? Bill’s mother{NEWLINE}is said to have been a dancer.{SCROLL}...So that’s it then.
strings.notes: US 0688/19; zh 舞女 (dancer), not 舞姬 (Kimono Girl)

strings.zh: 你知道吗？{NEWLINE}正辉先生的妈妈{CLEAR}以前好像是舞女。{SCROLL}⋯⋯好啦,再见！
strings.en: Did you know...? Bill’s mother{NEWLINE}is said to have been a dancer.{SCROLL}...So that’s it then.

strings.zh: 你还是那么闲啊,{NEWLINE}要不再来一场对战吧？{SCROLL}你还能看到我那些{NEWLINE}很少见的精灵,{CLEAR}绝对不会亏的。{SCROLL}我就在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}到了之后就来找我吧。
strings.en: You’re as idle as ever, huh? How about{NEWLINE}another battle?{SCROLL}You’ll get to see my rare Pokémon, so{NEWLINE}it’s definitely worth it.{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}. Come find me{NEWLINE}when you get there.
strings.notes: US 0688/21 | RV072: omission: restored 'come find me'

strings.zh: 你不想见见珍贵的精灵吗？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}{CLEAR}等你,你快来！
strings.en: You want to see my rare Pokémon?{NEWLINE}Hurry over to {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 你想听正辉先生的事吗？{SCROLL}不好意思我现在很忙,{NEWLINE}等有空了我会打给你。{CLEAR}你就耐心等着吧,{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: You want to hear about Bill?{SCROLL}Sorry, I’m busy right now. I’ll call{NEWLINE}you when I’m free, so just be patient.{SCROLL}Bye!
